It is a next-generation R Markdown and Jupyter Notebook interface that allows you to create dynamic documents, reports, presentations, and websites. ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` https://quarto.org/ screenshot completed ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-html/screenshot-quarto-org-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: :::: {.attribution} ::: ## What is Quarto? {{< iconify thinking-face >}} Quarto ([quarto.org](https://quarto.org/)): - is a **free and open-source software**, released under the GPL by [Posit, PBC](https://posit.co/). - is a **command line interface** (CLI). - mainly supports **Python**, **R**, **Julia**, and **Observable JavaScript**. - supports writing document as **Markdown** or **Jupyter Notebook**. - can build **HTML**, **PDF**, **Microsoft Word**, *etc.* - can build **websites**, **blogs**, **books**, *etc.*. - is built on **Pandoc**. ## What is Pandoc? {{< iconify thinking-face >}} :::: {layout="[0.30, 0.70]" layout-valign="center"} ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` https://pandoc.org/ screenshot completed ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-html/screenshot-pandoc-org-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: :::: {#pandoc-description} Pandoc ([pandoc.org](https://pandoc.org/)): - is a **free software**, released under the GPL by [John MacFarlane](http://johnmacfarlane.net/). - is a **command line interface** (CLI). - allows to **convert to and between multiple formats**. - **understands Markdown** syntax. - **understands LaTeX math** and macros. - handles **citations and bibliographies**. ::: ::: ## How does Quarto work? {{< iconify thinking-face >}} ```{mermaid} %%| fig-width: 10 %%{ init: { "theme": "dark", "themeCSS": ".label foreignObject, .cluster-label foreignObject { font-size: 90%; overflow: visible; }" } }%% flowchart LR A1[qmd] --> C{"knitr
